Would Arnold Schwarzenegger have been able to deadlift an adult Black rhinoceros at his peak strength?
</question>
<context>
Compare Arnold Schwarzenegger's peak conventional deadlift to an adult Black rhinoceros's mass, then account for the fact that deadlifting an animal is much harder than deadlifting an equivalent static barbell because of shape, balance, and safe grip/positioning constraints.
No, it is very unlikely. Arnold Schwarzenegger’s peak deadlift was roughly in the 250–320 kg range (depending on source and lift type), while an adult Black rhinoceros typically weighs about 800–1,400 kg. Even ignoring the animal’s awkward body shape, that is several times beyond his likely max, so he could not practically deadlift a full adult Black rhino.
